name: Contact Relationship Management
summary: A demo contact relationship management (CRM) system: sales automation, marketing automation, customer support and analytics. A Rust JSON API (Loco: Axum, SeaORM, PostgreSQL) and a Svelte 5 / SvelteKit 3 browser client built on the Lily Design System, specified in spec/. Demo software: synthetic data only, no real email is sent by default, no accreditation or certification is claimed.

stack.client: Svelte 5 runes, SvelteKit 3 (SPA mode), Lily Design System

notes: The specification in spec/ is the single source of truth; code and docs follow it.
Requirements are CRM-R<n> (spec/requirements.md); tasks are CRM-T<n> (spec/tasks.md). Every task traces to a requirement.
Be honest about limits: tasks.md records what was verified and what was not. Do not claim more than it does.
Translations (eight UI locales, role briefs in locales/) are machine drafts that no native speaker has reviewed.
Never put real personal data in examples, tests or fixtures; use synthetic data.
